collection.title: Audi Cabriolet 1991 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 1991 to 1996 version of the Audi Cabriolet which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
